nodes.speaker: Rosie
nodes.text: Papa! You're home. Where's Mama? Thomas said she's visiting but she didn't say goodbye.

choices.text: She loves you very much, Rosie. You know that, don't you.
She had to go away for a while, sweetheart. We'll talk tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Rosie
nodes.text: I know, Papa. She tells me every night.

nodes.speaker: Rosie
nodes.journal_entry: Her hands are so small. I have to hold on to that.

nodes.speaker: Rosie
nodes.text: Did she take her blue coat? She only goes long distances in the blue coat.
nodes.journal_entry: Rosie noticed the coat was still here. Six years old and she noticed.

nodes.text: Edmund turns and goes upstairs. Rosie watches the door.
nodes.journal_entry: I couldn't face her. What does that make me?
